basemaps.cartocdn.com.note: MapCanvas' default light/dark basemap style JSON and its raster/vector tiles.
basemaps.cartocdn.com.escapeHatch: Pass `mapStyle` to point at a self-hosted style, or `blank` to render no basemap.

carto.com.note: AttributionPanel link for the CARTO basemap credit. An <a href> the user clicks — not a fetch. The tiles themselves are basemaps.cartocdn.com, declared separately.
carto.com.escapeHatch: Don't render AttributionPanel's `data` category (it is only required while the Carto basemap is in use).

chanhdai.com.note: Attribution comment for the component ShimmeringText was adapted from. Never fetched.

chatgpt.com.note: OpenInChatGPT deep link. An <a href> the user clicks — not a fetch, so connect-src does not apply. It DOES carry the prompt text in the query string, so user content leaves your perimeter on click.

claude.ai.note: OpenInClaude deep link; carries the prompt in the query string.

cursor.com.note: OpenInCursor deep link; carries the prompt in the query string.

doi.org.note: Citation links built as https://doi.org/<doi> when a reference has no explicit url. An href, not a fetch.

ejiidnob33g9ap1r.public.blob.vercel-stor.note: Persona's six Rive .riv artwork files, fetched at runtime by the Rive WebGL2 runtime.
ejiidnob33g9ap1r.public.blob.vercel-stor.escapeHatch: Self-host the files (see PERSONA_SOURCES) and pass `<Persona src={…}>`; a blocked load renders the fallback orb.

elements.ai-sdk.dev.note: Attribution comment — @elabs-ai/components-ai is vendored from Vercel AI Elements. Never fetched.

github.com.note: AttributionPanel's provenance links — the upstream repo of every adapted/vendored source and every vendored font — plus the same credits as source comments (mapcn, Milkdown). Fixed provenance URLs carrying no user content. Never fetched.

models.dev.escapeHatch: Pass `src` for a self-hosted asset, or `fallback`; a blocked load renders a neutral glyph.

scira.ai.note: OpenInScira deep link; carries the prompt in the query string.

t3.chat.note: OpenInT3 deep link; carries the prompt in the query string.

v0.app.note: OpenInv0 deep link; carries the prompt in the query string.

www.apache.org.note: The canonical Apache-2.0 licence URL, carried in @elabs-ai/components-ai's vendored-from notice. Apache-2.0 §4 requires the notice to travel with the source, and this is its standard form. Never fetched.

www.npmjs.com.note: AttributionPanel links every OSS dependency to its npm page. Deliberately ONE origin for all ~95 dependencies (see npmUrl in scripts/gen-attributions.mjs) — linking each package's own homepage would inject dozens of arbitrary origins into this inventory and bury the entries that describe real fetches.
www.npmjs.com.escapeHatch: Don't render AttributionPanel's `dependency` category; the licence-required notices are in `data`/`font`.

www.openstreetmap.org.note: AttributionPanel link for the ODbL copyright page behind the OpenStreetMap credit. Required attribution while the Carto basemap is in use; an <a href>, never fetched.
www.openstreetmap.org.escapeHatch: Change the basemap (MapCanvas `styles`/`blank`) — the notice is only owed while OSM-derived tiles render.
